exposure: Gestational age (GA) <34 weeks vs. GA >=34 weeks
cohort: 2,543 preterm infants born with a gestational age (GA) between 22 +0 and 36 +6 weeks.
finding: AAB exposure was associated with decreased risks of feeding intolerance and neonatal infection, but the effects on body growth varied by the exposure level of AAB and GA of infants.
